data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kale', meaning 'beautiful, handsome, or joyful'. In the New Testament, the name Kay appears as a form of the name 'Katharina', which means 'pure'. The name Kay carries the meaning “Pure, Rejoicing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kay usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, rejoicing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kay total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
